scenes.say: Why bother automating tests in quality assurance? What’s the real benefit for engineers?

scenes.label: Coverage
scenes.sub: Automation boosts test coverage and speeds up feedback.
scenes.say: Automated tests help us check more features, faster. That means we spot issues sooner and cover more ground.
With continuous integration, we run tests every night, plug them into build pipelines, and automate regression checks. It saves time and keeps quality high.

scenes.question: Should you automate every test?
scenes.right: No, focus on stable, high-value regression tests first.
scenes.say: Here’s a common trap: Should you automate every test? Nope. Start with stable, high-value regression cases.
